Watch Lucinda Williams describe the first time she met Bob Dylan
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

On Friday, March 13, 2026, The Current welcomed Lucinda Williams to the Forum at Minnesota Public Radio to perform a MicroShow, hosted by Zach McCormick and recorded before a live studio audience. During her conversation with Zach, Williams recalled the very first time she met Bob Dylan. Watch Lucinda Williams tell that story in the video above. 

Watch the full set here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2CB8kmcAt1o

description:
Watch Lucinda Williams perform the title track to "World's Gone Wrong" at The Current
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

On Friday, March 13, 2026, The Current welcomed Lucinda Williams to the Forum at Minnesota Public Radio to perform a MicroShow, hosted by Zach McCormick and recorded before a live studio audience. Williams opened her set with "The World's Gone Wrong," the title track from her 2026 album. Doug Pettibone accompanies on guitar and backing vocals. 

Watch the full set here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2CB8kmcAt1o
